description: Defines a jQuery UI widget 'nestedSortable' for creating nested sortable lists with advanced options and behaviors.

methods.name: _create
methods.description: Initializes the nestedSortable widget, sets up classes and options based on list type and tree structure.

methods.name: _destroy
methods.description: Cleans up data and event handlers when the widget is destroyed.

methods.name: _mouseDrag
methods.description: Handles the dragging behavior, including auto-scrolling, level calculation, and placeholder positioning.

methods.name: _mouseStop
methods.description: Handles cleanup after dragging stops, including reverting position if beyond max levels.

methods.name: _intersectsWithSides
methods.description: Determines if the draggable intersects with container sides for nesting logic.

methods.name: _contactContainers
methods.description: Checks for contact with other sortable containers.

methods.name: _clear
methods.description: Clears empty list elements and resets state.
